name: graycart
title: graycart
blurb: a 160×144, 4-shade handheld with no manual. every visit rolls a fresh cartridge — new rules, sprites, sounds, and level, picked from dodging, gathering, maze-crawling, or climbing — and hands you a D-pad and two unlabeled buttons to figure it out with. @eggmansasshole.bsky.social asked for a Game Boy-like window that regenerates itself and leaves the player guessing; @bisks.net gave the go-ahead.
